title: Recording registration response v1 (proposed, unpublished)
description: POST /api/v1/recordings success data: 201 when created, 200 for an exact replay. recording is the unchanged http.recording.v1 shape. collectionPermissionRef is the server-bound operator approval recorded for the authenticated owner at registration; the phone copies it into recording-source/v1 collection_permission_ref. It identifies server state and is never accepted from a client as authority.
